name: Spirit Guide
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, paladin 1, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour

DESCRIPTION

A divine spirit guides you in performing certain tasks over the course of the spell’s duration, granting you a +1 divine bonus on all skill checks.

Spirit Guide, Greater

School divination; Level cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, paladin 3, ranger 3

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as spirit guide, except that the bonus to skill checks increases to +5.
